properties.name: flexiberry.base-packages
properties.description: Restrict scanning to controllers in specified package prefixes

properties.name: flexiberry.base-url
properties.description: Base URL prefixed to endpoints (e.g. http://localhost:8080)

properties.name: flexiberry.enabled
properties.description: Enable or disable Flexiberry spec generator

properties.name: flexiberry.file-name
properties.description: Default file name for the emitted .berry spec

properties.name: flexiberry.generate-on-startup
properties.description: Automatically write .berry spec on application startup

properties.name: flexiberry.infer-workflows
properties.description: Automatically infer sequential CRUD lifecycle tasks (Task ... Step Call Api ...)

properties.name: flexiberry.output-dir
properties.description: Target directory to write generated .berry files

properties.name: flexiberry.split-by-controller
properties.description: If true, generates a separate .berry file for each controller and links/imports them into the main entry file using the 'Link' keyword.
